text:
Source: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/c5823c7d54a18ef6352fa4593c2a9533a5bd9ed5

Coverage: Actual diff inspected; related inverse/reland duplicate hunks checked as a chain.
Read removal of three temporary Rust CI build variants. Removal paired with237 enabling Rust in normal jobs. Do not infer reduced Rust CI coverage merely from deleted task names.

commit c5823c7d54a18ef6352fa4593c2a9533a5bd9ed5
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Thu May 30 14:52:04 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Thu May 30 14:52:04 2024 +0000

    Bug 1896139 - Remove the build-rust CI jobs. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D210061

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
index 7944a147561..63f2db20e60 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
@@ -49,39 +49,6 @@ linux64/opt:
             - linux64-sccache
             - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
 
-linux64-rust/opt:
-    description: "Linux64 Opt w/ Rust Enabled"
-    index:
-        product: thunderbird
-        job-name: linux64-rust-opt
-    treeherder:
-        platform: linux64/opt
-        symbol: Brust
-        tier: 2
-    worker:
-        max-run-time: 7200
-        env:
-            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
-            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: rusty
-    run:
-        config:
-            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
-            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
-        extra-config:
-            extra_mozconfig_content:
-                - ac_add_options --enable-thunderbird-rust
-                - ac_add_options --disable-gtest-in-build
-    use-sccache: true
-    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
-    optimization:
-        never: null
-    fetches:
-        toolchain:
-            - linux64-libotr
-            - linux64-rust
-            - linux64-sccache
-            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
-
 linux64-shippable/opt:
     description: "Linux64 Shippable"
     attributes:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
index 723eeed37b4..0dd0a42b23c 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/macosx.yml
@@ -84,38 +84,6 @@ macosx64/opt:
             - macosx64-x64-libotr
             - macosx64-sdk
 
-macosx64-rust/opt:
-    description: "MacOS X x64 Cross-compile w/ Rust"
-    index:
-        job-name: macosx64-rust-opt
-    attributes:
-        enable-build-signing: true
-        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
-    treeherder:
-        platform: osx-cross/opt
-        symbol: Brust
-        tier: 2
-    worker:
-        max-run-time: 7200
-        env:
-            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
-            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: rusty
-    run:
-        config:
-            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
-            - builds/releng_base_mac_64_cross_builds.py
-        extra-config:
-            extra_mozconfig_content:
-                - ac_add_options --enable-thunderbird-rust
-                - ac_add_options --disable-gtest-in-build
-    use-sccache: true
-    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
-    fetches:
-        toolchain:
-            - linux64-sccache
-            - macosx64-x64-libotr
-            - macosx64-sdk
-
 macosx64-x64-shippable/opt:
     description: "MacOS X x64 Cross-compile"
     attributes:
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
index 9ab6ddac48b..c60c79999bf 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
@@ -215,59 +215,6 @@ win64/opt:
         fetch:
             - upx-3.95-win
 
-win64-rust/opt:
-    description: "Win64 Opt (Cross) w/ Rust"
-    index:
-        product: thunderbird
-        job-name: win64-rust-opt
-    attributes:
-        enable-build-signing: true
-        enable-full-crashsymbols: true
-    treeherder:
-        platform: windows2012-64/opt
-        symbol: Brust
-        tier: 2
-    worker-type: b-linux-gcp
-    worker:
-        max-run-time: 7200
-        env:
-            PERFHERDER_EXTRA_OPTIONS: rusty
-            MOZ_AUTOMATION_PACKAGE_TESTS: "1"
-    run:
-        actions: [build]
-        options: [append-env-variables-from-configs]
-        script: mozharness/scripts/fx_desktop_build.py
-        config:
-            - builds/taskcluster_base_thunderbird.py
-            - builds/releng_base_linux_64_builds.py
-        extra-config:
-            stage_platform: win64
-            mozconfig_platform: win64
-            extra_mozconfig_content:
-                - ac_add_options --enable-thunderbird-rust
-                - ac_add_options --disable-gtest-in-build
-    use-sccache: true
-    run-on-projects: ['comm-central']
-    optimization:
-        never: null
-    fetches:
-        toolchain:
-            - linux64-cbindgen
-            - linux64-clang
-            - linux64-dump_syms
-            - linux64-nasm
-            - linux64-node
-            - linux64-rust-cross
-            - linux64-rust-size
-            - linux64-sccache
-            - linux64-winchecksec
-            - linux64-wine
-            - sysroot-wasm32-wasi
-            - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
-            - win64-libotr
-        fetch:
-            - upx-3.95-win
-
 win64-shippable/opt:
     description: "Win64 Opt Shippable"
     index:
